_doc: Skill data in effect for a replay date. Snapshots are alpha123/uma-tools umalator-global/skill_data.json at the given commit (alpha's processed format). Fields map to master skill_data: alternatives[i] = precondition_i/condition_i/float_ability_time_i (baseDuration)/ability_time_usage_i (durationScaling); effects[j] = ability_type_i_j (type), float_ability_value_i_j (modifier), ability_value_usage_i_j (scaling), target_type_i_j (target); wisdomCheck = activate_lot. NOT tracked by alpha: float_cooldown_time_i, target_value_i_j, ability_value_level_usage_i_j, additional_activate_type_i_j, priority. For those use master.mdb (assumed unchanged).
